prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text: The provision for credit losses was $6.3 million in the third quarter of 2026, $9.0 million in the second quarter of 2026, and $8.4 million in the third quarter of 2025. The acquisition of Heartland resulted in a day-one provision of $1.9 million in the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the provision for credit losses was $16.1 million, compared to $22.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. See additional information in "ACL on Loans" in this report.

nonint.heading: Noninterest Expenses
nonint.text:
Noninterest expense for the third quarter of 2026 totaled $133.3 million, an increase of $10.2 million, or 8%, compared to the second quarter of 2026, and an increase of $31.3 million, or 31%, from the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, noninterest expense totaled $378.6 million, an increase of $94.3 million, or 33%, compared to the nine months ended September 30, 2025. Seacoast continues to prudently manage expenses while strategically investing to support continued growth. Year-over-year increases reflect continued expansion of the footprint and growth in customers, including through bank acquisitions. Noninterest expenses are detailed as follows:

Salaries and employee benefits totaled $63.4 million, an increase of $0.3 million, or 1%, from the second quarter of 2026, and an increase of $9.7 million, or 18%, from the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, salaries and employee benefits totaled $189.2 million, an increase of $31.9 million, or 20%, compared to the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

The Company utilizes third parties for its core data processing systems. Ongoing data processing costs are directly related to the number of transactions processed and the negotiated rates associated with those transactions.

tax.heading: Income Taxes
tax.text: For the third quarter of 2026, the Company recorded tax expense of $15.5 million, a decrease of $1.1 million, or 6%, compared to the second quarter of 2026 and an increase of $5.0 million, or 48%, compared to the third quarter of 2025. The effective tax rate for the third quarter of 2026 was 20.5%, compared to 21.7% in the second quarter of 2026 and 22.3% in the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, tax expense totaled $41.0 million, an increase of $8.6 million, or 26%, compared to the nine months ended September 30, 2025, with an effective tax rate of 21.3% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to 22.7% for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

net.text: • Net income of $59.9 million, or $0.55 per diluted share, increased 1% from the second quarter of 2026 and 64% from the third quarter of 2025. Adjusted net income 1 of $71.8 million, or $0.66 per diluted share, increased 9% from the second quarter of 2026 and 59% from the third quarter of 2025.

Net interest income.heading: Net Interest Income and Margin
Net interest income.text:
Net interest income for the third quarter of 2026 totaled $183.4 million, an increase of $3.0 million, or 2%, compared to the second quarter of 2026, and an increase of $49.9 million, or 37%, compared to the third quarter of 2025. The year-over-year increase was primarily driven by higher loan and securities balances resulting from the acquisitions completed in 2025. Interest income on loans in the third quarter of 2026 increased by $9.2 million, or 5%, compared to the second quarter of 2026, reflecting higher average loan balances and higher core loan yields. Securities income decreased $0.8 million, or 1%, compared to the second quarter of 2026, as improved securities portfolio yields were more than offset by lower average securities balances. Accretion on acquired loans was $8.5 million in the third quarter of 2026, $8.9 million in the second quarter of 2026, and $9.5 million in the third quarter of 2025. Interest expense on deposits increased $4.3 million, or 7%, compared to the second quarter of 2026, and increased $7.7 million, or 13%, compared to the third quarter of 2025, primarily due to higher average balances and higher rates.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net interest income totaled $540.2 million, an increase of $161.4 million, or 43%, compared to the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

Noninterest income.heading: Noninterest Income
Noninterest income.text:
Noninterest income totaled $31.6 million for the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $3.8 million, or 14%, compared to the second quarter of 2026, and an increase of $7.8 million, or 33%, compared to the third quarter of 2025. Noninterest income totaled $46.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, a decrease of $23.8 million, or 34%, compared to the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

Noninterest income is detailed as follows:

Service charges on deposits totaled $7.1 million in the third quarter of 2026, a nominal increase compared to the second quarter of 2026, and an increase of $0.9 million, or 14%, compared to the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, service charges on deposits totaled $21.0 million, an increase of $4.1 million, or 24%, compared to the nine months ended September 30, 2025. Year-over-year growth is primarily attributable to bank acquisitions in 2025 and growth in customer relationships.

Wealth management income, including trust fees and brokerage commissions and fees, was $6.1 million in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $0.1 million, or 2%, from the second quarter of 2026 and an increase of $1.5 million, or 33%, compared to the third quarter of 2025.

lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Deposits
